# Blue Tick Trading School

> Blue Tick Trading School is an online financial literacy and trading mentorship academy in India, founded by Amit Gupta. The school specializes in institutional price action, BankNifty and Nifty derivatives trading, Smart Money Concepts (SMC), and disciplined risk management.

## Key Facts & Entity Information
- **Organization:** Blue Tick Trading School
- **Founder & Head Mentor:** Amit Gupta (10+ years active market experience)
- **Primary Website:** https://blueticktrading.com
- **Helpline / WhatsApp:** +91 80048 55663
- **Support Email:** support@blueticktrading.com
- **Focus Markets:** Indian Equities (NSE/BSE), BankNifty, Nifty 50, FINNIFTY, Futures & Options (F&O), Commodity & Forex.
- **Regulatory Status:** Educational only. Strictly NOT a SEBI-registered investment advisor or stock tipping service.

## Core Mentorship Curriculum
1. **Price Action & Technical Analysis:** Candlestick psychology, support/resistance dynamics, trendlines, volume spread analysis.
2. **BankNifty & Nifty Options Buying:** High-momentum intraday breakout setups, Option Greeks management, avoiding theta decay traps.
3. **Institutional Smart Money Concepts (SMC):** Fair Value Gaps (FVG), order blocks, liquidity sweeps, 1:3+ risk-to-reward frameworks.
4. **Market Psychology & Risk Control:** Position sizing algorithms, eliminating emotional trading, post-market trade journaling.
